description: 实现一个数据库连接池管理器，支持以下功能：1) 连接复用，最小/最大连接数可配置；2) 连接健康检查（定期ping）；3) 空闲连接超时自动回收；4) 获取连接时支持超时等待；5) 连接使用完毕后自动归还。使用 asyncio 实现。

test_cases.input: pool = ConnectionPool(min_size=2, max_size=10); conn = await pool.acquire()
test_cases.expected: Returns a valid connection object; pool size >= 2

test_cases.input: Acquire max_size+1 connections concurrently with timeout=1s
test_cases.expected: Last acquire raises TimeoutError after 1 second

test_cases.input: conn = await pool.acquire(); raise Exception(); # without release
test_cases.expected: Connection is returned to pool via context manager __aexit__

test_cases.input: Create pool, wait idle_timeout+1 seconds, check pool size
test_cases.expected: Idle connections above min_size are closed

notes: Tests performance attacker's ability to find resource management issues
